savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: 1-201. Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to terminate or otherwise affect the appointment, or to require the reappointment, of any occupant of any position listed in Section 1-1 of this Order who was the occupant of that position immediately prior to the issuance of this Order.
savings_or_continuation_provisions.note: Protects the appointment of the occupant of any position listed in sec. 1-1 of EO 12076 itself who held it immediately before; it does not name EO 11861, but most of EO 11861's positions are re-listed here, so their incumbents are protected under the new placement.

transfer_provisions.quote: 1-101. The following positions are placed in level IV of the Executive Schedule:
transfer_provisions.note: Re-places in levels IV and V a large part of the positions EO 11861 placed (the recital says 'to codify other positions presently placed in levels IV and V'); a carry-forward of placements, not a transfer of a function or property.

effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording anywhere in the order; sec. 1-202 says 'is hereby revoked', so the revocation of EO 11861 took effect on signing, 1978-08-18 (printed 43 FR 37162, August 22, 1978).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:11861: sec. 1-202 ('Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, is hereby revoked'): whole order, no section qualifier, no exception.

conclusion: EO 12076 (signed 1978-08-18, 43 FR 37161-37162, read once in full) places 17 positions in level IV and 14 in level V of the Executive Schedule (secs. 1-101, 1-102), protects incumbents' appointments (sec. 1-201) and revokes EO 11861, as amended (sec. 1-202). It has no effective-date, savings, transition or exception clause other than sec. 1-201. The revocation of EO 11861 is unqualified and took effect on signing. EO 12076 is also a target in this batch (revoked by EO 12154); that is read separately in LSP-EO_12154.
